title: 第15章 八品武者瞬间秒杀第16章 突破先天萧霓凰回京
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
“谁告诉你，我不是武者的？”
话音落下的瞬间，楚风身上一股磅礴如山的武道气息轰然爆发，如决堤的江河，朝着洛青当头压下！
八品武者！
经过昨夜借助葬天棺的吞噬炼化，他的武道境界早已今非昔比，从五品一跃踏入了八品之境！
“八……八品武者？”
洛青脸上的得意与掌控瞬间凝固，整个人如遭雷击，眼珠子瞪得几乎要从眼眶里凸出来。
“不，不可能！
这绝对不可能！
你怎么可能是八品武者？”
他彻底乱了，心神巨震。
一个全京城都知道的武道废柴，一个连武道门槛都摸不到的废物，怎么可能一夜之间，变成一个连他都要仰望的八品武者？
这比天方夜谭还要荒谬！
洛青下意识地揉了揉眼睛，几乎以为自己是中了什么幻术。
然而，那股沉重如山的气息却无比真实，压得他骨骼作响，连呼吸都变得困难起来。
“你……”
他指着楚风，喉咙里挤出一个字，还想说些什么。
可楚风已经没了耐心。
他身形一晃，鬼魅般出现在洛青面前，五指如钳，精准地扣住了对方的喉咙。
“额……”
洛青双脚离地，脸色瞬间涨成了猪肝色，双手死死地抓住楚风的手腕，却撼动不了分毫。

“你可以，上路了。”
楚风神色淡漠，仿佛在说一件微不足道的小事。
咔嚓！
一声清脆的骨裂声在寂静的夜里格外刺耳。
洛青的挣扎戛然而止，眼中的神采迅速黯淡下去，到死他都没想明白，自己究竟招惹了一个什么样的怪物。
楚风随手一甩，洛青的尸体便被扔在地上，发出一声闷响。
另一边，正与冷月激战的白鹰眼角余光瞥见这一幕，鹰隼般的眸子骤然一缩。
世子……死了？
噗！
就是这刹那的分神，冷月抓住了破绽，手中匕首划过一道冰冷的弧线，在他胸前带起一串血珠。
“呃！”
白鹰闷哼一声，身形暴退，他看着洛青那已经没了声息的尸体，脸色难看到了极点，随即猛地盯向楚风，厉声喝道：“你竟敢杀洛世子？”
“他想杀我，我为什么不能杀他？”
楚风撇了撇嘴，反问道。
白鹰眼神闪烁不定，下一秒，他猛地转身，化作一道黑影就朝着远处窜去。
如今洛青都死，他再打下去毫无意义，而且这小丫头实力不逊于他，再纠缠下去，自己怕是也要交代在这里。
“冷月，别让他跑了！”
楚风的声音传来。
咻！
content_en:
"Who told you that I am not a warrior?"
The moment the words fell, Chu Feng's martial arts aura burst out as majestic as a mountain, pressing down on Luo Qing like a river bursting its banks!
Eighth-grade warrior!
After the devouring and refining with the help of the Sky Burial Coffin last night, his martial arts realm is no longer what it used to be, and he jumped from the fifth level to the eighth level!
"Eighth...eighth-level warrior?"
The pride and control on Luo Qing's face froze instantly. His whole body felt as if he was struck by lightning, and his eyes were so wide that they almost bulged out of their sockets.
"No, impossible!
This is absolutely impossible!
How could you be an eighth-level warrior? "
He was completely confused and mentally shaken.
How could a martial arts loser known throughout the capital, a loser who could not even touch the threshold of martial arts, turn into an eighth-level warrior who even he looked up to overnight?
This is even more ridiculous than a fantasy!
Luo Qing rubbed his eyes subconsciously, almost thinking that he was under some illusion.
However, that heavy mountain aura was extremely real, making his bones crack and even breathing became difficult.
"You..."
He pointed at Chu Feng, squeezed out a word in his throat, and wanted to say something else.
But Chu Feng had lost his patience.
He swayed and appeared in front of Luo Qing like a ghost. His fingers were like pincers and he grasped the opponent's throat with precision.
"Um..."
Luo Qing's feet left the ground, his face instantly turned the color of pig liver, and he grabbed Chu Feng's wrist with both hands, but he couldn't shake it at all.
"You can, get on your way."
Chu Feng looked indifferent, as if he was talking about a trivial matter.
Click!
A crisp bone cracking sound was particularly harsh in the silent night.
Luo Qing's struggle came to an abrupt end, and the look in his eyes quickly dimmed. Until his death, he never understood what kind of monster he had provoked.
Chu Feng flicked it casually, and Luo Qing's body was thrown to the ground with a muffled sound.
On the other side, Bai Ying, who was fighting fiercely with Leng Yue, caught a glimpse of this scene from the corner of his eye, and his falcon-like eyes suddenly shrank.
The prince... is dead?
puff!
In this moment of distraction, Leng Yue seized the flaw, and drew a cold arc with the dagger in his hand, bringing up a string of blood beads on his chest.
"Ugh!"
Bai Ying groaned and retreated violently. He looked at Luo Qing's voiceless body, his face turned extremely ugly, and then he stared at Chu Feng and shouted sternly: "How dare you kill Luo Shizi?"
"He wants to kill me, why can't I kill him?"
Chu Feng curled his lips and asked.
Bai Ying's eyes flickered uncertainly, and the next second, he turned around suddenly, turned into a black shadow and ran towards the distance.
Now that Luo Qing is dead, there is no point in him continuing to fight, and this little girl is not inferior to him in strength. If he continues to struggle, he may have to answer here.
"Leng Yue, don't let him run away!"
Chu Feng's voice came.
call out!
